newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville heavy load power mostly steady for Weds.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville heavy load power mostly steady for Weds.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) was holding offer prices for heavy load surplus electricity for Wednesday delivery mostly steady, the agency said Tuesday.

Standard firm power during heavy load hours Wednesday was being offered steady at $22.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), with power to the Northwest valued steady at $23.00 and California-Oregon Border (COB)/Nevada Oregon Border (NOB) held at $24.50.
The heavy-hour limit was increased to 400 megawatts (MW) from 200 MW for Tuesday delivery, BPA said.
Standard firm power for Wednesday during light load hours was being offered at $17.50, with the Northwest and COB/NOB valued at $18.00 with a 200 MW limit.
Standard non-firm power for Wednesday delivery was offered at $19.50 per MWh with the Northwest and COB/NOB set at $20.00 with a 400 MW limit, BPA said.
Non-firm power for Tuesday had been offered at $21.25, with the Northwest priced at $22.00 and COB/NOB at $23.50 with a 400 megawatt limit.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
